description:
Track time per thread, billable or not. Entries are stored in threads/<Kind>/<Name>/hours.md.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD DESCRIPTION [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — append an entry
  list [THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — totals by thread and currency; unbilled time in a separate row
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT] [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — change one field of an entry
  rm ID -y — delete an entry

Flags:
  log:
    THREAD             thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
    DESCRIPTION        short invoice line item; required in practice; pass as one element
    -m, --minutes N    duration (default 60); must be positive
    -r, --rate N       hourly rate; 0 = unbillable; needs a currency
    -c, --currency CODE  ISO code (default: the thread's). With no currency here or on the thread, the entry is unbilled
    -d, --date DATE    YYYY-MM-DD (default today)
    -t, --time HH:MM   start time (default now)
  list, report:
    THREAD / --thread THREAD  only this thread
    --since DATE, --until DATE  inclusive YYYY-MM-DD bounds
    --json
  edit:
    --description TEXT  new description; takes several words, so put it last
    -m, --minutes N     new duration; start time unchanged
    -r, --rate N        new rate; needs a currency
    -c, --currency CODE new ISO code
    -d, --date DATE     move to this day; duration kept
    -t, --time HH:MM    move to this start time; duration kept
  rm:
    -y, --yes  required to confirm

Args:
  ID  8-char entry id from hours list

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/Northwind", "Data model review", "-m", "90"]
  ["log", "Projects/Northwind", "Workshop prep", "-m", "120", "-d", "2026-10-20", "-t", "09:00"]
  ["report", "--since", "2026-10-01", "--json"]
  ["edit", "1a2b3c4d", "-m", "45"]

Notes:
  log also adds a REF: to buffer.md, filed under the work date, which goes into the daily log on buffer flush.
  Keep descriptions short labels. Search does not index them; record detail with buffer add-text.
  rm is permanent and fails without -y.
  Nothing prompts.
  Exit 1: --minutes not positive, rate without a currency, empty description, editing an entry that has a rate but no currency.
